instrument: Broker XAUUSDm spot-gold CFD in USD, not GC futures
entry: M15 EMA50/EMA200, close/EMA50 and EMA50 5-bar slope agree; M5 bullish/bearish EMA20 reclaim from prior other side, close beyond EMA50, RSI14 buy 50..68 or sell 32..50; last 6 M5 consecutive
stop: last 3 M5 structural extreme plus 0.2 ATR14, at least 1.2 ATR14 from actual entry; ask correction for SELL
targets: 1R/2R/3R/4R cost-reserved tick-rounded; nearest confirmed 2-left/2-right M15 swing among last 120 closed complete M15 bars less 0.2 M5 ATR buffer; skip absent/insufficient room
strong_target_requirements: 3R/4R require M15 abs EMA50-EMA200 >= M15 ATR14 and abs EMA50 slope5 >= 0.25 M15 ATR14, M5 ATR/median100 <= 1.5; otherwise at most 2R
clock_blackouts: America/New_York weekday 08:15..09:00, 09:45..10:15, 13:45..14:30, start inclusive/end exclusive; fixed clock proxy, not an event calendar or protection for existing positions
execution: one position; next M5 open; no pyramiding, retries, tightening stop to fit minimum lot, or target changes after entry
research: No outcome optimization; chronological 60% development, 20% validation, 20% recent by calendar time after 1200-bar warmup. Base modeled costs, zero-extra-fee, double-slippage-and-fee stress; 100:1 margin is illustrative; M5 bar spread is not tick history; stop-first ambiguous bars; no historical swap verification
